'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Mike Kessling DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessling]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Valar'''. Username '''Kessling'''. L3 EPP Vader → Darth Vader With Lightsaber. L33 YMSYL → You May Start Your Landing. L45 sheet Holon laser → Ion Cannon. L53 sheet SRE/WYTS → Search And Destroy (expansion uncertain).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Kessling
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
